record.question: An invoice of Rs.2500 has the following terms: cash 4, 2/10, 1/20, n/30. Find the discount if the payment is made on the 4th day
record.explanation: Apply the graduated invoice terms according to the actual payment day, not the immediate-cash incentive. The immediate-cash4% term is distinct from2/10 (2% within10days),1/20 (1% for the later discount window) and n/30 (net due30days). Payment on day4 falls within the2/10 window. Discount=Rs.2,500×2%=Rs.50. The compressed cash4 notation is preserved; no official examiner key is claimed. Review note: Supersedes first-pass Rs.100. Root and independent follow-up distinguish immediate payment from day4 credit payment. Primary educational source: https://libraryguides.centennialcollege.ca/c.php?g=645085&p=5114199 Verified solution (unofficial); original PDF and derivation reviewed26October2026.
